sentences.en: American forces announced the completion of their mission in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 美国军队宣布他们在伊拉克的任务已经完成。

sentences.en: They told us they wanted to call off the mission.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们想取消这次任务。

sentences.en: The mission took the direct route by air to the boundary.
sentences.zh: 这次任务通过空运直接飞到了边界附近。

senses.zh: 给…交代任务；派遣；把任务交给

mnemonic: 电影《碟中碟》Mission Impossible ，直译为《不可能完成的任务》
